title: Brian Flores's lawyers seek information from NFL about Jon Gruden, Colin Kaepernick cases

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brian Flores's lawyers seek information from NFL about Jon Gruden, Colin Kaepernick cases
sources.description: The lawsuit filed by Vikings defensive coordinator Brian Flores against the NFL and various teams has finally moved forward (as to several of the pending claims) to the discovery process.
